已经发生的卸载与存档删除不能撤销；若原应用身份发生变化，将停止清理并提示检查。
messages.en:
First tap Cancel and close the old Android installation/uninstallation dialog. After confirmation, only the original app will be checked, the retained request token canceled, and old records cleared. The old installation/uninstallation will not reopen or continue.

Completed uninstallation and save deletion cannot be undone. If the original app identity has changed, cleanup will stop and a check will be required.

messages.zh:

卸载主程序或清除数据会失去密钥；将来可能需要再次卸载游戏。生成密钥和准备 APK 本身不会卸载任何应用。
messages.en:
A private key stored only in this device's Android Keystore is needed to sign the game APK after adding the save bridge. Original game code and resources keep their original bytes. This app and the game use separate UIDs. The key is never uploaded or sent to the game.

Uninstalling this app or clearing its data loses the key; you may need to uninstall the game again later. Generating the key and preparing the APK do not uninstall any app.

messages.zh:
本次替换必须先卸载原游戏。卸载会不可逆地永久删除全部本地存档和战绩。

APK 备份不是存档备份，不能恢复已删除的存档。卸载前取消会保留原版；卸载后中断只能保留已准备好的安装包，不能找回存档。

卸载和安装都仍需在 Android 系统界面单独确认。
messages.en:
This replacement requires uninstalling the original game first. Uninstalling irreversibly and permanently deletes all local saves and rankings.

An APK backup is not a save backup and cannot recover deleted saves. Canceling before uninstall keeps the original game. Interruption after uninstall preserves only the prepared APKs and cannot recover saves.

Uninstalling and installing each still require separate confirmation in the Android system interface.

messages.zh: 存在未完成存档恢复，请先处理恢复记录，不能转交安装包。
messages.en: Save recovery is unfinished. Handle recovery records before handing off APKs.

messages.zh: 当前游戏包含拆分 APK；通用安装器入口不能只安装 base.apk，已停止转交。
messages.en: This game contains split APKs. A generic installer cannot install only base.apk. Handoff stopped.

messages.zh: 安装请求已变化。
messages.en: The installation request changed.

messages.zh: 系统请求已变化，请重新检查。
messages.en: The system request changed. Check again.

messages.zh: 当前安装会话目标与安装包不一致。
messages.en: The current installation session target differs from the APKs.

messages.zh: 无法确认旧会话身份，请先处理失效请求再选择其他安装器。
messages.en: Cannot verify the old session identity. Handle the expired request before choosing another installer.

messages.zh: 旧安装会话目标不一致，未关闭或转交。
messages.en: The old installation session target differs. It was not closed or handed off.

messages.zh: 旧会话不属于本应用或安装仍在进行，未启动其他安装器。请先完成或取消原安装。
messages.en: The old session does not belong to this app or installation is still in progress. No other installer was launched. Complete or cancel the original installation first.

messages.zh: 旧安装会话尚未结束，未启动其他安装器。请稍后重试。
messages.en: The old installation session has not ended. No other installer was launched. Try again later.

messages.zh: 旧安装请求已关闭，正在准备其他安装器。
messages.en: The old installation request is closed. Preparing another installer.

messages.zh: 已准备交给你选择的安装器；返回后请检查安装结果。不会自动卸载游戏。
messages.en: Ready to hand off to your chosen installer. Check the installation result when you return. The game will not be uninstalled automatically.

messages.zh: 尚未核验到本次准备的游戏版本、签名与内容。请在所选安装器完成安装后再次检查。
messages.en: The prepared game version, signature, and contents have not yet been verified as installed. Complete installation in your chosen installer and check again.

messages.zh: 已安装游戏在核验期间发生变化，请重新检查。
messages.en: The installed game changed during verification. Check again.

messages.zh: 已核验当前已安装游戏：版本、签名和 APK 内容与本次准备一致。
messages.en: The installed game is verified: its version, signature, and APK contents match this preparation.

messages.zh: 尚未发现已安装的目标游戏。请在所选安装器完成安装后再次检查。
messages.en: The target game is not installed yet. Complete installation in your chosen installer and check again.

messages.zh: 安装器未能打开，已撤回 APK 读取授权，安装包仍保留。
messages.en: The installer could not be opened. APK read access was revoked. The APKs are preserved.

messages.zh: 已结束等待并撤回 APK 读取授权。这不会停止其他安装器已经开始的安装，请先确认其操作已结束再重试。
messages.en: Waiting ended and APK read access was revoked. This does not stop installation already started by another installer. Confirm that it has finished before retrying.

messages.zh: 游戏组件已就绪。
messages.en: Game components are ready.

messages.zh: 安装已取消或未完成，安装包已保留。
messages.en: Installation was canceled or incomplete. The APKs are preserved.

messages.zh: 还没有待处理的系统安装操作。
messages.en: There is no pending system installation operation.

messages.zh: 原游戏曾被卸载，本机原存档和战绩不能由 APK 恢复。
messages.en: The original game was uninstalled. Its original local saves and rankings cannot be restored from APKs.

messages.zh: 已有系统安装或卸载尚未结束，请先继续或取消该操作。
messages.en: A system install or uninstall is still pending. Continue or cancel that operation first.

messages.zh: 存在未完成存档恢复，请先处理恢复记录后再更换游戏。
messages.en: Save recovery is unfinished. Handle recovery records before changing games.

messages.zh: 游戏 APK 集合与内置存档桥已暂存并通过签名与内容校验，尚未卸载或安装应用。
messages.en: The game APK set and embedded save bridge are staged and passed signature and content verification. No app has been uninstalled or installed.

messages.zh: 旧版助手安装流程已停用。请先处理原有恢复记录，再重新准备带内置存档桥的游戏。
messages.en: The legacy helper installation flow is disabled. Handle existing recovery records, then prepare the game with the embedded save bridge again.

messages.zh: 未找到完整的安装包，请重新准备游戏。
messages.en: The complete APK set was not found. Prepare the game again.

messages.zh: 无法核对旧系统请求对应的准备记录，尚未清理请求。
messages.en: Cannot verify the preparation record for the old system request. The request has not been cleared.

messages.zh: 旧系统请求的应用与保留的准备记录不匹配，尚未清理请求。
messages.en: The old system request's app differs from the retained preparation record. The request has not been cleared.

messages.zh: 系统请求必须只指向已验证的游戏，不能安装或卸载独立助手。
messages.en: System requests must target only the verified game. They cannot install or uninstall a separate helper.

messages.zh: 请先完成上一个系统请求。
messages.en: Complete the previous system request first.

messages.zh: 安装包或现有应用已变化。请重新检查后再次确认，尚未请求卸载。
messages.en: The APKs or existing app changed. Check and confirm again. Uninstallation has not been requested.

messages.zh: 存在未完成存档恢复，不能卸载游戏。请先处理恢复记录与备份。
messages.en: Save recovery is unfinished. The game cannot be uninstalled. Handle recovery records and backups first.

messages.zh: 等待 Android 系统卸载确认与结果。尚不能确认应用是否被删除。
messages.en: Waiting for Android system uninstall confirmation and result. App deletion is not yet confirmed.

messages.zh: 系统拒绝创建卸载请求，未请求系统删除应用。请检查设备限制。
messages.en: The system refused to create an uninstall request. App deletion was not requested. Check device restrictions.

messages.zh: 上一个系统安装请求尚未结束，请勿重复提交。
messages.en: The previous system installation request is still pending. Do not submit it again.

messages.zh: 未允许安装应用，已取消本次安装。
messages.en: App installation was not allowed. This installation was canceled.

messages.zh: 当前应用仍需用户确认卸载，不能直接覆盖安装。
messages.en: Uninstalling the current app still requires user confirmation. It cannot be overwritten directly.

messages.zh: 安装包已交给 Android，等待系统确认或结果。
messages.en: The APKs were handed to Android. Waiting for system confirmation or result.

messages.zh: 未能启动安装，安装包已保留。
messages.en: Installation could not start. The APKs are preserved.

messages.zh: 系统安装请求已失效，请取消后重试。
messages.en: The system installation request has expired. Cancel it and try again.

messages.zh: 系统确认已失效，请检查失效请求或取消当前安装。
messages.en: System confirmation has expired. Check the expired request or cancel the current installation.

messages.zh: 失效的系统安装请求已清理，安装包仍保留。可以重新选择游戏或重试安装。
messages.en: The expired system installation request was cleared. The APKs are preserved. You can select a game again or retry installation.

messages.zh: 目标安装内容已变化，不能继续旧卸载请求。
messages.en: Target installation contents changed. The old uninstall request cannot continue.

messages.zh: 原游戏或已验证安装包发生变化，不能续用旧卸载确认。请关闭系统对话框并重新检查。
messages.en: The original game or verified APKs changed. The old uninstall confirmation cannot be reused. Close the system dialog and check again.

messages.zh: 存在未完成存档恢复，不能继续卸载游戏。请先处理恢复记录。
messages.en: Save recovery is unfinished. Uninstallation cannot continue. Handle recovery records first.

messages.zh: 系统确认入口可用，正在打开。
messages.en: System confirmation is available. Opening it now.

messages.zh: 原系统确认令牌仍有效，请继续该请求并在系统界面确认或取消。
messages.en: The original system confirmation token is still valid. Continue that request and confirm or cancel in the system interface.

messages.zh: 需先确认旧系统对话框已关闭。
messages.en: First confirm that the old system dialog is closed.

messages.zh: 现有应用身份已变化，不能续用旧卸载许可。请重新准备并检查。
messages.en: The existing app identity changed. The old uninstall approval cannot be reused. Prepare and check again.

messages.zh: 系统请求已变化，请重新检查，未清理任何请求。
messages.en: The system request changed. Check again. No requests were cleared.

messages.zh: 系统确认已恢复，请继续该请求并在系统界面确认或取消。
messages.en: System confirmation was restored. Continue this request and confirm or cancel in the system interface.

messages.zh: 系统会话目标不一致，未取消或清理请求。
messages.en: The system session target differs. The request was not canceled or cleared.

messages.zh: 失效请求已结束，安装包仍保留。尚未重新请求卸载；点击继续后会重新核验并再次警告、确认。
messages.en: The expired request ended. The APKs are preserved. Uninstallation has not been requested again. Continuing will reverify and show the warning and confirmation again.

messages.zh: 旧版失效请求已清理，准备记录仍保留。请重新核对现有安装并准备内置存档桥游戏；不会继续旧版安装或卸载。
messages.en: The expired legacy request was cleared. Preparation records are preserved. Recheck the existing installation and prepare the game with the embedded save bridge. Legacy installation or uninstallation will not continue.

messages.zh: 请先在 Android 中取消并关闭旧安装／卸载界面，再明确确认清理。
messages.en: Cancel and close the old Android install/uninstall screen first, then explicitly confirm cleanup.

messages.zh: 旧系统请求的操作类型无法核对，尚未清理。
messages.en: Cannot verify the old system request's operation type. It has not been cleared.

messages.zh: 仅能清理已关闭界面、身份未变的旧版请求；尚未清理或重试任何操作。
messages.en: Only a legacy request with a closed screen and unchanged identity can be cleared. No operation has been cleared or retried.

messages.zh: 系统安装会话与旧请求目标不一致，尚未取消会话。
messages.en: The system installation session target differs from the old request. The session has not been canceled.

messages.zh: 你已确认在系统中取消并关闭旧界面；已核对原应用身份未变，仅清理旧请求令牌与记录。请重新准备内置存档桥游戏。
messages.en: You confirmed canceling and closing the old system screen. The original app identity is unchanged. Only the old request token and record were cleared. Prepare the game with the embedded save bridge again.

messages.zh: 已取消旧版待处理安装会话并清理请求记录。不会继续旧版安装；已经发生的安装或卸载不能撤销，请重新检查并准备游戏。
messages.en: The pending legacy installation session was canceled and its request record cleared. Legacy installation will not continue. Completed installs or uninstalls cannot be undone. Check again and prepare the game.

messages.zh: 请使用检查安装结果或结束等待处理其他安装器请求。
messages.en: Use “Check installation result” or “End waiting” to handle another installer's request.

messages.zh: 目标应用已变化，安装已停止。
messages.en: The target app changed. Installation stopped.

messages.zh: 安装已取消，准备好的安装包仍保留。
messages.en: Installation canceled. The prepared APKs are preserved.

messages.zh: 请在 Android 卸载界面确认或取消；应用不会自动同意。
messages.en: Confirm or cancel in the Android uninstall screen. This app will not agree automatically.

messages.zh: 请在 Android 安装界面确认或取消；应用不会自动同意。
messages.en: Confirm or cancel in the Android install screen. This app will not agree automatically.

messages.zh: 未能打开系统安装确认，请点击继续系统确认重试。
messages.en: Cannot open system installation confirmation. Tap “Continue system confirmation” to retry.

messages.zh: 请点击“继续系统确认”，在 Android 卸载界面取消。系统确认尚未结束，不能当作原应用已保留。
messages.en: Tap “Continue system confirmation” and cancel in the Android uninstall screen. System confirmation is still pending, so the original app cannot be assumed preserved.

messages.zh: 已取消待处理安装请求。准备好的 APK 仍保留；已经发生的卸载不能撤销。
messages.en: The pending installation request was canceled. Prepared APKs are preserved. Any completed uninstall cannot be undone.

messages.zh: 系统确认已恢复，请继续系统确认。
messages.en: System confirmation restored. Continue system confirmation.

messages.zh: 系统卸载已取消或未完成，原应用仍在。继续前会重新检查并再次请求确认。
messages.en: System uninstallation was canceled or incomplete. The original app remains. Continuing will recheck and request confirmation again.

messages.zh: 现有应用已变化，请重新准备游戏。
messages.en: The existing app changed. Prepare the game again.

messages.zh: 已确认应用被卸载。已验证的安装包仍在，可点击继续安装。
messages.en: The app is confirmed uninstalled. The verified APKs remain. Tap to continue installation.

messages.zh: APK 来源文件缺失或为空。
messages.en: The source APK file is missing or empty.

messages.zh: APK 来源长度已变化。
messages.en: The source APK length changed.

messages.zh: 系统写入 APK 集合校验失败。
messages.en: System-written APK set verification failed.

messages.zh: APK 写入校验信息无效。
messages.en: Invalid APK write verification data.

messages.zh: APK 来源超过已验证长度。
messages.en: The source APK exceeds its verified length.

messages.zh: APK 写入字节数或 SHA-256 与已验证来源不一致。
messages.en: The APK byte count or SHA-256 differs from the verified source.

messages.zh: APK 来源在写入期间发生变化。
messages.en: The source APK changed during writing.

messages.zh: 系统暂存 APK 文件名集合不一致。
messages.en: The system-staged APK filename set differs.

messages.zh: Root 选择属性重复
messages.en: Duplicate root selection property

messages.zh: Root 选择超出限制
messages.en: Root selection exceeds limit

messages.zh: Root 选择无效
messages.en: Invalid root selection

messages.zh: 不支持的 Root 选择版本
messages.en: Unsupported root selection version

messages.zh: APK 选择重复
messages.en: Duplicate APK selection

messages.zh: 来源证明标记无效
messages.en: Invalid provenance flag

messages.zh: 未知 Root 选择字段
messages.en: Unknown root selection fields

messages.zh: 缺少 Root 选择
messages.en: Missing root selection

messages.zh: Root 选择文件无效
messages.en: Invalid root selection file

messages.zh: 缺少 Root 选择字段
messages.en: Missing root selection field

messages.zh: Root 选择数值无效
messages.en: Invalid root selection number

messages.zh: 外部安装包身份无效。
messages.en: Invalid external APK identity.

messages.zh: 无法创建外部安装暂存目录。
messages.en: Cannot create the external installation staging directory.

messages.zh: 已验证安装包的路径已变化。
messages.en: The verified APK path changed.

messages.zh: 无法将外部安装包设为只读。
messages.en: Cannot make the external APK read-only.

messages.zh: 无法保存只读外部安装记录。
messages.en: Cannot save the read-only external installation record.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录已失效，安装包原件仍保留。
messages.en: The external installation record expired. The original APKs are preserved.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录不完整。
messages.en: The external installation record is incomplete.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录过长。
messages.en: The external installation record is too long.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录身份不匹配。
messages.en: The external installation record identity does not match.

messages.zh: 外部安装包缺失或长度已变化。
messages.en: The external APK is missing or its length changed.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录数值无效。
messages.en: Invalid external installation record number.

messages.zh: 外部安装包内容已变化，已停止安装。
messages.en: The external APK contents changed. Installation stopped.

messages.zh: 无法删除已撤销的外部安装副本。
messages.en: Cannot delete the revoked external installation copy.

messages.zh: 外部安装暂存目录包含未知文件，已保留。
messages.en: The external installation staging directory contains unknown files and was preserved.

messages.zh: 外部安装记录标识无效。
messages.en: Invalid external installation record identifier.

messages.zh: 外部安装包校验信息无效。
messages.en: Invalid external APK verification data.

messages.zh: 应用私有目录不可用。
messages.en: The app-private directory is unavailable.

messages.zh: 无法建立外部安装目录。
messages.en: Cannot create the external installation directory.

messages.zh: 外部安装目录无效。
messages.en: Invalid external installation directory.

messages.zh: 外部安装路径不安全。
messages.en: Unsafe external installation path.

messages.zh: 探测预算无效
messages.en: Invalid probe budget

messages.zh: 沙箱订单参数无效。
messages.en: Invalid sandbox order parameters.

messages.zh: 沙箱身份验证未完成。
messages.en: Sandbox authentication is incomplete.

messages.zh: 沙箱未允许这次操作。
messages.en: The sandbox did not allow this operation.

messages.zh: 沙箱订单状态有冲突，请刷新原订单。
messages.en: Sandbox order state conflicts. Refresh the original order.

messages.zh: 沙箱服务暂不可用。
messages.en: The sandbox service is temporarily unavailable.

messages.zh: 赞赏服务版本不支持。
messages.en: Donation service version unsupported.

messages.zh: 已拒绝沙箱地址跳转。
messages.en: Sandbox address redirect rejected.

messages.zh: 沙箱响应超过大小限制。
messages.en: The sandbox response exceeds the size limit.

messages.zh: 沙箱请求超时。
messages.en: The sandbox request timed out.

messages.zh: 沙箱连接中断。
messages.en: The sandbox connection was interrupted.

messages.zh: 沙箱未接受这次请求。
messages.en: The sandbox did not accept this request.

messages.zh: 沙箱响应不符合约定。
messages.en: The sandbox response does not match the contract.

messages.zh: 操作结果未确认，请查询原订单并保留原请求标识，不要新建替代订单。
messages.en: The operation result is unconfirmed. Check the original order and preserve its request identifier. Do not create a replacement order.

messages.zh: 存档桥已恢复并验证中断前备份（%1$d 个文件）。
messages.en: The save bridge restored and verified the pre-interruption backup (files: %1$d).

messages.zh: Root 恢复记录已处理并重新核对（%1$d 个文件）。
messages.en: Root recovery records were handled and rechecked (files: %1$d).

messages.zh: Root 存档访问未完成（%1$s）。请保留游戏安装，重新检查授权与目标。
messages.en: Root save access did not complete (%1$s). Keep the game installed and recheck authorization and the target.

messages.zh: 同步检查未完成：%1$s（%2$s）失败。请复制脱敏诊断查看具体原因。
messages.en: Sync check incomplete: %1$s (%2$s) failed. Copy the redacted diagnostics for details.

messages.zh: 系统安装请求在 %1$s 阶段未完成。
messages.en: The system installation request did not complete at the %1$s stage.

messages.zh: 已停止本次退出同步监听。下次从本应用启动游戏会重新开启。
messages.en: This exit-sync watcher stopped. It will restart the next time you launch the game from this app.

messages.zh: 已停止本次退出同步监听。已提交的上传仍可能完成，请检查原连接。下次从本应用启动游戏会重新开启。
messages.en: This exit-sync watcher stopped. Submitted uploads may still complete; check the original connection. It will restart the next time you launch the game from this app.

messages.zh: Android 的后台数据同步时限已到，本次监听已停止。可从首页检查或下次启动游戏时重新开启。
messages.en: Android's background data sync time limit was reached. This watcher stopped. Check from the home screen or restart it when you next launch the game.

messages.zh: Android 的后台数据同步时限已到，本次监听已停止。已提交的上传仍可能完成，请检查状态。可从首页检查或下次启动游戏时重新开启。
messages.en: Android's background data sync time limit was reached. This watcher stopped. Submitted uploads may still complete; check their status. Check from the home screen or restart it when you next launch the game.

messages.zh: 自动上传未完成：%1$s（%2$s）
messages.en: Automatic upload incomplete: %1$s (%2$s)

messages.zh: badges.dat 缺少合并分支
messages.en: badges.dat has no branches to merge

messages.zh: badges.dat/badges 基线
messages.en: badges.dat/badges baseline

messages.zh: 设置窗口已关闭，请重新打开
messages.en: Settings was closed. Please reopen it.

messages.zh: 正在测试连接，请稍候
messages.en: Testing the connection. Please wait.

messages.zh: 连接已取消
messages.en: Connection canceled

messages.zh: 这个地址下没有可用的 WebDAV 根目录（HTTP 404），请检查服务地址。不会创建上层目录。
messages.en: No usable WebDAV root exists at this address (HTTP 404). Check the service address. Parent directories will not be created.

messages.zh: 服务地址或同步路径被同名文件占用，不能用作同步文件夹。请检查 WebDAV 地址。
messages.en: The service address or sync path is occupied by a file and cannot be used as a sync folder. Check the WebDAV address.

messages.zh: 认证失败（HTTP 401），请检查用户名和密码。
messages.en: Authentication failed (HTTP 401). Check your username and password.

messages.zh: 账号没有访问或创建同步目录的权限（HTTP 403），请检查 WebDAV 权限。
messages.en: This account cannot access or create the sync directory (HTTP 403). Check WebDAV permissions.

messages.zh: 服务器找不到同步文件夹的父目录（HTTP 409），请检查服务地址及目录状态后重试。
messages.en: The server cannot find the sync folder's parent directory (HTTP 409). Check the service address and directory, then retry.

messages.zh: 服务器未接受目录创建或验证（HTTP %1$s），请检查 WebDAV 服务后重试。
messages.en: The server rejected directory creation or verification (HTTP %1$s). Check the WebDAV service and retry.

messages.zh: 服务器返回的目录验证信息无效，已停止创建。请检查 WebDAV 地址及服务兼容性。

With incomplete evidence, cumulative statistics conservatively use the larger value and may undercount.
